# runbrowser

> Hosted Chromium you drive over CDP with Playwright, Puppeteer, or anything else that speaks it.
> EU-hosted (Falkenstein, Germany). Sessions are billed by the second.

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/quickstart.md): Connect an existing Playwright or Puppeteer script in one line, in TypeScript or Python.
- [Concepts](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/concepts.md): Sessions, the session lifecycle, billing granularity, stable sessions, stealth, proxies and the live viewer.

## Reference

- [API reference](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/api-reference.md): Every endpoint: the CDP WebSocket, sessions, fetch, search and extract, with request and response shapes.
- [Errors](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/errors.md): Every status code and error code the API returns, with cause, fix, and whether it is worth retrying.

## Integrations

- [MCP server](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/mcp.md): The hosted MCP server: browser tools for Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients.
- [From Browserless](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/migrating-from-browserless.md): Endpoint-by-endpoint mapping from Browserless, including what we do not have.
- [From Browserbase](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/migrating-from-browserbase.md): Mapping from Browserbase, including contexts vs stable sessions and the gaps.

## Optional

- [Pricing](https://runbrowser.dev/#pricing): Plan limits and prices.
